answer.rationale: p99 latency degradation is confined to primary region during peak settlement traffic. Regional failover has a proven track record (memory_b2: fast latency restoration, clean traffic shift, error recovery within minutes during the March degradation). This action preserves the mandatory security patch (rules out rollback), maintains write capacity (rules out circuit breaker which would shed load), and avoids the latency cost of provisioning headroom under peak load. Read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses reporting load, not write path latency. The constraint of one intervention and the clear regional isolation make failover the highest-confidence play here.
